title: Claude expands autonomous workflows with Projects, Scheduled #claudeai #automation #aitechnology
description: Claude introduced a new ecosystem that enhances productivity with Projects, Scheduled Tasks, Computer Use, and Routines. Projects act as memory folders that retain instructions and files, while Scheduled Tasks automate daily workflows. Computer Use allows Claude to control your computer and complete tasks independently. Routines enable fully autonomous background automations, freeing users from manual input. These features mark a significant step in AI integration for seamless, continuous assistance and workflow automation, promising to transform how users manage tasks and maintain productivity. #ClaudeAI #ClaudeEcosystem #AITasks #WorkflowAutomation #ArtificialIntelligence #AIAutomation #AITechnology #ProductivityTools #AIIntegration #SmartAutomation #ComputerControl #AutonomousAI #InnovationInAI #TechAutomation #FutureOfWork
